title: SecurityPolicy
description: Schema for security-policy.yaml. Loaded with PyYAML and validated against this schema by the gate and contracts/validate.py.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1. Increment requires a contract amendment.

mode.description: enforce: policy violations block deployment. audit: violations are reported but never block.

max_allowed.description: Maximum number of secret findings allowed before the gate fails.

critical.description: Max Critical-severity vulnerability findings. null means unlimited.

high.description: Max High-severity vulnerability findings. null means unlimited.

medium.description: Max Medium-severity vulnerability findings. null means unlimited.

low.description: Max Low-severity vulnerability findings. null means unlimited.

must_run_as_non_root.description: If true, the gate fails if the container image is configured to run as root.

banned_base_tags.description: List of banned base image tags. Any Dockerfile FROM using one of these tags causes a gate failure.

id.description: Finding id (SHA-256 fingerprint), CVE ID, or rule_id to waive.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the waiver no longer applies.

approved_by.description: GitHub handle or name of the person who approved this waiver.

scope.description: Optional file glob. If provided, the waiver only applies to findings in matching files.

waivers.description: List of approved waivers. Evaluated by the gate (P4) in Phase 4.
